en.headline: Hospital Authority appeals for liver donor for 13-year-old boy
en.dek: The boy at Queen Mary Hospital is in serious condition with severe liver failure and complications, topping the O+ waiting list as officials prepare to seek mainland assistance.
body: The Hospital Authority has issued an urgent public appeal for a suitable liver donor for a 13-year-old boy being treated at Queen Mary Hospital in Pok Fu Lam.

The authority said on Thursday evening that the patient is in serious condition with severe hepatic failure and recurrent complications including hyperammonaemia and cholangitis. Clinicians have assessed him as requiring an urgent transplant and placed him at the top of the waiting list for an O+ blood-group liver.

In addition to the local search, the authority is preparing to seek assistance through the Hong Kong government from the mainland. Under the existing cross-boundary mechanism, a compatible organ from a willing donor who dies on the mainland and has no suitable local recipient may be matched to a patient in Hong Kong.

The spokesman stressed that any transplant would follow relevant laws and regulatory standards, with formal applications made once a suitable organ is identified. The authority also encouraged the public to consider organ donation of deceased relatives.

zh.headline: 醫管局呼籲為13歲男童尋找肝臟捐贈者
zh.dek: 男童現於瑪麗醫院留醫，情況嚴重，肝功能衰竭並有併發症，位列O+血型輪候名單首位，當局正準備向內地尋求協助。
body: 醫院管理局緊急呼籲市民支持器官捐贈，為一名在瑪麗醫院留醫的13歲男童尋找合適肝臟。
醫管局發言人指，該名病人肝功能嚴重衰竭，持續出現高血氨症及膽管炎等併發症，臨床評估後急需接受肝臟移植，現時位列O+血型肝臟移植輪候名冊首位。
除積極在本地尋找外，醫管局已準備透過特區政府向內地尋求協助。根據跨境器官配對機制，若內地有願意捐贈者離世而當地無合適受贈者，可協調將器官配對到香港。
發言人強調，一旦尋獲合適肝臟，將嚴格按照相關法規從速向監管機構申請，並盡快安排手術。醫管局亦呼籲市民積極考慮捐出離世親人的器官。
